evidence_items.claim: Completed migration to Murex MX.3 platform for FX, FX derivatives, equities, and commodities trading in May 2024
evidence_items.excerpt: Commerzbank has successfully completed its migration of FX, FX derivatives, equities and commodities trading to the Murex MX.3 platform in partnership with Murex, TeamTek and Infosys

lr_mapping.rationale: Traditional vendor platform migration suggests pragmatist approach without CDM layer

evidence_items.caveats: Vendor announcement. Migration to traditional platform (Murex MX.3) does not indicate CDM adoption. Murex has CDM capabilities but no evidence Commerzbank using CDM layer.
